title: A Survey on Multimodal Benchmarks: In the Era of Large AI Models
reasoning: The survey systematically reviews benchmarks within its 'Safety' and 'Trustworthiness' categories (Section 4.1.2) that are specifically designed to evaluate whether MLLMs generate ethically sound outputs, avoid harmful or inappropriate content, and adhere to ethical standards such as fairness and privacy. It includes reviews of benchmarks like MM-SafetyBench, MLLMGuard, and RTVLM.
